name: 博尼法乔·安朱斯
awards: 2014年 第67届洛迦诺国际电影节 金豹奖 (提名) 鳏夫独歌
name_full: 博尼法乔·安朱斯 Bonifacio Angius
introduction: Bonifacio Angius (Sassari, 1982) is a director, screenwriter, actor, director of photography, and film producer. Critics have taken notice; he is considered one of the most original voices to emerge on the contemporary Italian film scene. His first film, Perfidia, screened in competition at the Locarno Film Festival in 2014 to overwhelming critical acclaim and earned Angius the Junior Jury Award. Four years later, his next film, Ovunque proteggimi premiered at the Torino Film Festival and, this time as well, was a critics’ and audience favorite. In 2018, his short Destino, in which Angius also plays the starring role, was tapped for the International Critics’ Week as the special event closing film. His third feature, I giganti, screened at the Locarno Film Festival in 2021.
